# Christie's

> > Christie's is a world-leading art and luxury auction house offering sales of fine art, decorative arts, jewelry, and collectibles from historic estates and private collections.

Christie's conducts prestigious auctions featuring works by masters like Magritte, Picasso, Degas, and Dalí, as well as exceptional decorative arts including Tiffany Studios lamps and art glass. The auction house specializes in Impressionist, Modern, and American art alongside rare collectibles from renowned private collections.

## Key Topics

- Christie's auctions
- Tiffany Studios art glass and lamps
- Louis Comfort Tiffany
- Impressionist and Modern art
- Works on paper
- Private collections (Albert Zuckerman, Ronald and Madelyn Katz)
- Decorative arts auctions
- René Magritte, Edgar Degas, Salvador Dalí, Pablo Picasso
- American Visionaries
- New York auction sales
- Fine art collecting
- Surrealism and Modernism
- Art glass and lighting
- Estate sales

## Decorative Arts & Tiffany Studios Auctions

- [Tiffany](https://www.christies.com/auction/auction-23755-nyr/overview): Tiffany Studios auction featuring Albert Zuckerman Collection & rare lamps

## Impressionist & Modern Art Auctions

- [Impressionist and Modern Works on Paper](https://www.christies.com/auction/auction-23458-nyr/overview): Works on paper sale with Magritte, Degas, Dalí & Picasso from Berggruen
